rejected_rule.statement: In confirming the scheme, the trial judge has the discretion to adopt the partition scheme prepared by the Commissioner, with any modifications he considers justified.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Our courts have time and again observed that the phrase 'the court shall, after a summary inquiry, confirm such scheme with or without modifications' in Section 37 (2) of the Partition Law should not be interpreted as permitting only minor alterations.
